capabilities: Edit Mermaid diagrams in inline and full-screen Live Editors
Apply theme-matched styles and reusable preset classes
Export diagrams as SVG or PNG
Convert Flowchart and Agentflow diagrams into Obsidian Canvas
Render mermaid and pele code blocks with Pele
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.14.5 or later on desktop. Uses the bundled Pele renderer, so some diagrams may look different. Full documentation is hosted externally; Ko-fi and Buy Me a Coffee links are included.
intentEvidence: Edit Mermaid diagrams inside inline and full-screen Live Editors.
problem: Mermaid diagrams in Obsidian are hard to edit inline, style consistently, and export in common formats.
summary: Mermaid diagram editor that renders inline and full-screen, applies reusable styles, and exports SVG, PNG, or Canvas.
